_why: Two failure modes app/actions/newsletter.ts can produce that the existing newsletter.err.* vocabulary has no honest word for. Reusing a near-miss key was the alternative and it lies to the operator: 'not_admin' ('Brak uprawnień') would tell an admin their role is wrong when the real answer is that a built-in template is not theirs to delete, and 'missing' ('Nie znaleziono') would claim a campaign does not exist when it does and has simply moved on since the page was rendered.

pl.newsletter.err.state: Ta kampania zmieniła stan, odkąd otworzyłeś tę stronę. Odśwież i spróbuj jeszcze raz.
pl.newsletter.err.builtin: Szablonu wbudowanego nie da się usunąć. Skopiuj go i edytuj kopię.

en.newsletter.err.state: This campaign has changed state since you opened this page. Refresh and try again.
en.newsletter.err.builtin: A built-in template cannot be deleted. Copy it and edit the copy.

de.newsletter.err.state: Diese Kampagne hat ihren Status geändert, seit du diese Seite geöffnet hast. Lade sie neu und versuche es erneut.
de.newsletter.err.builtin: Eine eingebaute Vorlage kann nicht gelöscht werden. Kopiere sie und bearbeite die Kopie.
